Data:Leiter.aladim.json.desc: Al-Adim did not see his ideals reflected in the Institute's founding principles. He has faithfully carried messages to the Institute's allies and spoken on its behalf to the other branches of the Watchman's Tree. But, particularly now the Vagabond is acknowledged to be among the uncounted Hours, this son of the Rose is unlikely to stay with the Institute much longer.

Data:Leiter.aladim.mission.peace.json.desc: 'I do not know whether the Vagabond has risen to the Glory, or fallen to Nowhere. I grieve for her. So many Hours uncounted… but we endure, and our havens against the war. Peace never lasts, but war always ends. Now I am History's son, not Eternity's child.'

Data:Leiter.aladim.mission.stone.consume.desc: 'I, too, have been ruthless. I have made alliances where I must. We have survived the Wars below and above, as so many did not. The Vagabond is gone; it is a relief to find a new purpose. I do not regret my decisions.'

Data:Leiter.aladim.mission.stone.remembe.desc: 'I grieve for her, as I grieve for the other Hours uncounted, risen to the Glory, lost to Nowhere, consumed by the Cross… I am not a warrior; I am a messenger; and the message of remembrance, I will bear like a green bough into the dawn.'

Data:Leiter.arthur.foe.chandler.json.desc: 'I've been looking for the New King again. Still no sign - not since Caen. I do believe that with his passing we have to worry a great deal less about the Chandler. But there are still Names of the Chandler out there, like sparks on the wind… I fear we've only deferred the Dawn. And so, I hunt.'

Data:Leiter.arthur.foe.devourers.json.desc: 'This isn't the work I was born to do, but it's damned sure the work I was made for. I'm just back from Nantes - what's left of it. The place was overrun with the speechless dead. So many of them… but a lot fewer now. It's good work, and I'm good at it.'

Data:Leiter.arthur.json.desc: Arthur's ideals were not reflected in the Institute's founding principles, but he has long been a good soldier, and he will serve dutifully as Vigilant… until, perhaps, one day he is required to compromise his principles one last time.

Data:Leiter.arthur.mission.autarchy.json.desc: 'I'm spending most of my time in the Alps, now, keeping the Haven trouble-free. I miss the Labyrinth sometimes. But I don't miss the desert. The sun on the snow is clear and bright…'

Data:Leiter.arthur.mission.peace.json.desc: 'I thought my soldiering days were past. I've thought that before. Well, it's not exactly soldiering. I'll say instead that I thought my days of getting shot at were past. I chose this life with the Institute, though, and I'm proud.'

Data:Leiter.arthur.mission.revelation.js.desc: 'Light.' That's always the answer. Even the Moth knew it. It's been messy, the last few years, but I had sought the mercy of shadow for far too long. I'm enjoying the sunlight.

Data:Leiter.arthur.mission.stone.consume.desc: 'There was something big under the Brecons. Call it a Stone-name. Call it a Coils-child. Call it a failed dragon… long gone, half-eaten. But a lot of it left. I saw it reaped. It'll serve us well. We are doing good work out there. But I still dream about the lines of it against the moon.'

Data:Leiter.arun.ally.carapace.json.desc: 'The Carapace Cross? They're exiles. They're shiny. Some of them sing. Of course I like them.'

Data:Leiter.arun.ally.reckoners.json.desc: 'With the Madrugad among the Hours uncounted… my Reckoner friends and I have had room to wriggle. I've been arranging for the distribution of years, in secret. It won't last. We'll have to find a new paradigm when History is ravelled up again. But for now drink deep, my dears, drink deep!'

Data:Leiter.arun.json.desc: The Institute's mission and principles were not Arun's. But it has always been very difficult to determine what exactly Arun's principles actually are. He will work with the Institute, leashing or releasing its secrets, wreathing its operations in his customary riddles. Perhaps, one day, he will be its last and longest surviving member.

Data:Leiter.arun.mission.better.gods.jso.desc: 'Well, it's not exactly what I expected, but I never claimed to be a prophet. It's for the best. Without our work, I doubt we'd see one month still stitched to another. The new powers will settle down in time, as they always do, and join with whatever uncounted Hours emerge from night. Still no sign of the Chandler, either, I notice. I think that's for the best, too.'

Data:Leiter.arun.mission.revelation.json.desc: 'What was it I used to say? 'It's always too late, eventually? But until then it never is?' The servants of the Duties, shorn of the Calyptra's protection, scurrying about like ants without a queen; they're still trying to silence the dreamer and the dream… but it's too late; too late.'

Data:Leiter.azita.ally.reckoners.json.desc: 'I know not everyone liked the idea of working with the Reckoners, but they've been very useful. We have eyes in every city still standing. We have a consistent source of years to armour my agents - our agents. And I like them: they're professionals.'

Data:Leiter.azita.foe.chandler.json.desc: 'There is no sign of the New King since he fell at Caen. If he truly fell. His protector is tricksy… but the Chandler-Names still burn in Europe, and I fear they may find sympathy with the Ministries. No matter. If the Chandler ever surfaces, I will be here with my little knife to trim his wick.'

Data:Leiter.azita.foe.devourers.json.desc: 'Since the Wars, it is very difficult to keep the nights safe. But I and mine have done my best for the Institute, and for the helpless ones we protect. Yes, my own operations run a little more smoothly with fewer prowling Hügelkinder… but as we used to say in my homeland, the same fire melts gold and iron.'

Data:Leiter.azita.json.desc: Azita would have liked the Institute to choose another path. But Azita has always been morally flexible and commercially motivated. As long as it is profitable for her to work with the Institute, she will do so - and the Institute will benefit in turn from her superb network of contacts.

Data:Leiter.azita.mission.autarchy.json.desc: 'We could buy from the Ministries or the Incorporates. They're not Hours; it's not against our founding principles. But I like our independence. I've set up our own networks - our own suppliers… I had a lot to work with already.'

Data:Leiter.azita.mission.corrivality.js.desc: 'My dearest enemy, Mehrad, is sulking. He did not like that I would take no side in the Wars. He'll get over it. And in any case, with the Colonel among the Hours uncounted… I wonder how our arrangement might have changed.'

Data:Leiter.azita.mission.peace.json.desc: 'Peace? Why not? When a forest enjoys decades without a fire… then the conflagration, when it comes, is all the more glorious. Besides: my dearest enemy Mehrad is sulking.'

Data:Leiter.chaima.foe.chandler.json.desc: 'I think the New King truly fell at Caen. I had no part of it; his enemy was one I would never work with. But the other harbingers of the Chandler… one by one we snuff their flames. One day they will all be ashes.'

Data:Leiter.chaima.foe.devourers.echidna.desc: 'There is always another quarry. I am always sufficient to the task… but I have been requested to spare the khalvites. So I will. For now.'

Data:Leiter.chaima.foe.devourers.forbid..desc: 'There is always another quarry. I am always sufficient to the task.'

Data:Leiter.chaima.json.desc: Chaima would have chosen something other than this. But for now, she hunts the Institute's enemies, and she keeps her peace.

Data:Leiter.chaima.mission.corrivality.j.desc: 'There was more mercy in me once. No more.'

Data:Leiter.connie.foe.devourers.echidna.desc: 'We've had to take it easy on the khalvites because… you know… the Persistent. I suppose there are always compromises. But I don't like it.'

Data:Leiter.connie.foe.devourers.forbid..desc: 'I miss the resources I used to have. But working with the Institute… it's a lot less formal. Reminds me of the old days, before I joined the Bureau.'

Data:Leiter.connie.foe.nowhere.json.desc: 'There was a cast-off Worm-skin in the White Museum - where the Bureau kept the bones of its trophies. That's the closest I'd ever got to a Worm in expansive mode. I've been a lot closer since. I can't say I enjoy it. But the work needs doing.'

Data:Leiter.connie.foe.ys.json.desc: 'The insidiates of Ys are so… polite, you know? I keep finding myself beginning to relax my guard. I keep telling myself it's because they're cold-blooded… I don't know if that's literally true.'

Data:Leiter.connie.json.desc: It might be that some days, Connie wishes she'd stayed at the Suppression Bureau. But she's grown used to compromise. She'll work with the Lighthouse Institute until they come to a parting of the ways.

Data:Leiter.connie.mission.autarchy.json.desc: 'I was right to defy Lady Edith. I had no idea how compromised the Bureau had become. This Institute is a new start… well, new starts always tarnish, but I've been careful about our allies. It isn't always easy, but I've had enough of compromises.'

Data:Leiter.connie.mission.secrecy.json.desc: 'The Bureau has its flaws; Calyptra is a kind of tyranny; but the last few years have shown us how necessary the Duties are. You can't deny the sea, but you can build flood defences… and that's what we're doing: flood defences for knowledge.'

Data:Leiter.connie.mission.stone.consume.desc: 'This looting of god-bones… there is something grubby about it. But at the Bureau I learnt that we do what we must, not what we want. Using what's left of the gods-from-stone… it gives us more choice about 'must'. I am tired of compromises. But I do what I must.'

Data:Leiter.connie.resigned.foe.devourer.desc: 'We've had to take it easy on the khalvites because… you know… the Persistent. I suppose there are always compromises. But I don't like it.'
'I miss the resources I used to have, back before I left the Bureau. But working with the Institute… it's a lot less formal. Reminds me of the old days.'

Data:Leiter.connie.resigned.foe.nowhere..desc: 'There was a cast-off Worm-skin in the White Museum - where the Bureau kept the bones of its trophies. That's the closest I'd ever got to a Worm in expansive mode. I've been a lot closer since. I can't say I enjoy it. But the work needs doing.'

Data:Leiter.connie.resigned.foe.ys.json.desc: 'The insidiates of Ys are so… polite, you know? I keep finding myself beginning to relax my guard. I keep telling myself it's because they're cold-blooded… I don't know if that's literally true.'
